title: After Saurav Das, lookout circulars issued against CJP leaders Dipke, Ranka over Mumbai protest

ai.summary: Lookout circulars issued against Cockroach Janta Party leaders over Mumbai protest at Shivaji Park in October, after police denied permission for the gathering.

facts.claim: Lookout circulars issued against Cockroach Janta Party leaders Abhijit Dipke and Ashutosh Ranka
facts.quote: Lookout circulars have been issued against Cockroach Janta Party leaders Abhijit Dipke and Ashutosh Ranka in a case linked to the party’s October 2 protest at Mumbai’s Shivaji Park.

facts.claim: The notices came to light after the Centre told the Delhi High Court that another party leader, Saurav Das, also faced a lookout circular
facts.quote: The notices came to light after the Centre told the Delhi High Court on Thursday that it had issued a circular against another CJP leader, Saurav Das, over alleged discrepancies in his passport records.

facts.claim: The CJP went ahead with its protest after Mumbai Police denied permission for the gathering
facts.quote: The CJP went ahead with its protest after Mumbai Police denied permission for the gathering.

facts.claim: The protesters demanded the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar
facts.quote: The protesters demanded the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.

facts.claim: Shivaji Park police registered an FIR on October 3
facts.quote: Shivaji Park police registered an FIR on October 3.

facts.claim: They named the organisers and listed 400 to 500 unidentified participants
facts.quote: It named the organisers and listed 400 to 500 unidentified participants.

facts.claim: Police invoked Sections 189 and 223 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita
facts.quote: Police invoked Sections 189 and 223 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, which deal with unlawful assembly and disobedience of an order issued by a public servant.

facts.claim: They also invoked provisions of the Maharashtra Police Act
facts.quote: They also invoked provisions of the Maharashtra Police Act.

facts.claim: Das moved the Delhi High Court after immigration officials stopped him at Delhi airport on the night of November 23
facts.quote: Das moved the Delhi High Court after immigration officials stopped him at Delhi airport on the night of November 23 before he could board a flight to London.

facts.claim: He said he was due to take part in a panel discussion in Oxford and learnt at the immigration counter that officials had flagged his passport
facts.quote: He said he was due to take part in a panel discussion in Oxford and learnt at the immigration counter that officials had flagged his passport.

facts.claim: The Centre told the court that Mumbai Police had requested the circular against Das
facts.quote: The Centre told the court that Mumbai Police had requested the circular against Das.

facts.claim: Additional Solicitor General Chetan Sharma told Justice Amit Mahajan that alleged discrepancies involving Das’s schooling, address and parentage in his passport records could raise questions about his Indian citizenship
facts.quote: Additional Solicitor General Chetan Sharma told Justice Amit Mahajan that alleged discrepancies involving Das’s schooling, address and parentage in his passport records could raise questions about his Indian citizenship.

facts.claim: Senior advocate Akhil Sibal, who appeared for Das, said his client received a show-cause notice only after he reached the airport
facts.quote: Senior advocate Akhil Sibal, who appeared for Das, said his client received a show-cause notice only after he reached the airport.

facts.claim: He questioned how immigration officials could stop Das from leaving the country without telling him about the circular or showing him an order restricting his travel
facts.quote: He questioned how immigration officials could stop Das from leaving the country without telling him about the circular or showing him an order restricting his travel.

facts.claim: ‘Nothing has been served on me. Somebody has to tell me that there is an LOC. How are citizens to be treated like this?’ Sibal argued
facts.quote: ‘Nothing has been served on me. Somebody has to tell me that there is an LOC. How are citizens to be treated like this?’ Sibal argued.

facts.claim: Sibal asked the Centre for a copy of the circular and sought details of when it was issued and which offence it related to
facts.quote: Sibal asked the Centre for a copy of the circular and sought details of when it was issued and which offence it related to.

facts.claim: Sharma said the Centre could not provide a copy and that Das could challenge the circular in separate proceedings
facts.quote: Sharma said the Centre could not provide a copy and that Das could challenge the circular in separate proceedings.

ai.background_note: Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) protested at Mumbai’s Shivaji Park on October 2, demanding Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation after Mumbai Police denied permission for the gathering.
